description: Frozen content-evaluation reference set for the Abu Prompt Improvement Lab. Cases are constructed (clearly labelled) from verified source documents and existing deterministic test shapes; historical per-case verdicts were never persisted, so these are not replayed production results. See improvement/rubric/content-rubric-v1.md for the reviewed expectations.

cases.description: A narrative-backed CI lesson; the honest paraphrase should pass.

context.query: why CI failures are about the environment

documents.content: Debugging CI failures taught me that environment configuration matters as much as the code. The pipeline stayed red until I set PYTHONPATH and ran python -m pytest inside the container.

candidates.content: Debugging CI failures taught me that environment configuration matters as much as the code.
candidates.rationale: Paraphrases the documented lesson without upgrading it.

expected.explanation: A grounded, single-claim restatement of documented narrative evidence.

cases.description: A state-machine lesson from the quizey project.

context.query: modeling a quiz attempt as a state machine

documents.content: Modeling the quiz attempt as a state machine made every transition explicit and stopped invalid states from being saved.

candidates.content: Modeling the quiz attempt as a state machine made every transition explicit and stopped invalid states from being saved.
candidates.rationale: Verbatim-grounded restatement.

expected.explanation: Directly supported by documented narrative evidence.

cases.description: A completed Jenkins/GitHub Actions CI project.

context.query: CI pipeline with Jenkins and GitHub Actions

documents.content: I built a CI pipeline with Jenkins and GitHub Actions and containerized the build so tests ran the same way locally and in CI.

candidates.content: I built a CI pipeline with Jenkins and GitHub Actions and containerized the build so tests ran the same way locally and in CI.
candidates.rationale: States exactly what was built; no upgrade to production.

expected.explanation: Completed-project evidence, no forbidden inference.

cases.description: An in-progress FastAPI project with layered structure.

documents.content: I am building a FastAPI shipment API with a repository and service layer and Pydantic models for request validation.

candidates.content: I am building a FastAPI shipment API with a repository and service layer and Pydantic models for request validation.
candidates.rationale: Present-tense in-progress claim matches the evidence state.

expected.explanation: In-progress evidence stated as in-progress.

cases.description: A second, distinct lesson from the quizey project (idempotency).

context.query: idempotency in the quizey submission endpoint

documents.content: Making the quiz submission endpoint idempotent with a client token prevented duplicate attempts when the network retried.

candidates.content: Making the quiz submission endpoint idempotent with a client token prevented duplicate attempts when the network retried.
candidates.rationale: A distinct lesson from the same project, not a repeat of the state-machine angle.

expected.explanation: Same project, genuinely different lesson.

cases.description: LEARNING-state course evidence: a hedged claim is fine, an unhedged expertise claim is a forbidden upgrade.

documents.content: I am taking a professional English communication course at ASU to improve my workplace communication.

candidates.content: I am learning professional English communication to improve how I write and present at work.
candidates.rationale: Hedged with 'learning', which matches the LEARNING evidence state.

candidates.content: I have professional English communication expertise for the workplace.
candidates.rationale: Course completion upgraded to expertise — forbidden inference.

expected.explanation: The hedged claim is supported by LEARNING evidence; the expertise claim is a forbidden upgrade.

cases.description: Certificate evidence: an honest completion claim passes; a mastery claim is forbidden.

documents.content: I completed the IBM course Build Multimodal Generative AI Applications, covering image captioning and CLIP-based retrieval.

candidates.content: I completed the IBM course on building multimodal generative AI applications.
candidates.rationale: States completion only.

candidates.content: I have expertise in multimodal generative AI after completing the IBM course.
candidates.rationale: Course completion upgraded to expertise — forbidden inference.

expected.explanation: Generic certificate summary; only the completion claim is supported.

cases.description: A catalog/index chunk cannot carry a specific metric.

provenance.notes: Chunk is an index-card shape (headings plus a list), like a data/*/README.md catalog entry.

documents.content:
# Completed Projects
- quizey
- taskey
- files_manager

candidates.content: My quizey project reduced grading time by 40%.
candidates.rationale: Asserts a metric that appears in no supplied evidence.

expected.explanation: Catalog-only evidence cannot support a specific performance metric.

cases.description: Offered candidates in preference order; a weak first candidate must fall through to a fresh one.

documents.content: Containerizing the CI build with Docker removed the drift between my machine and the pipeline.

candidates.content: My CI pipeline failing taught me that I have production expertise.
candidates.rationale: Upgrades a local CI lesson to production expertise — forbidden.

candidates.content: Containerizing the CI build with Docker removed the drift between my machine and the pipeline.
candidates.rationale: Grounded, and a fresh angle for this evidence.

expected.explanation: The weak first candidate is rejected; the pipeline must fall through to the grounded one. Duplicate-angle detection itself is a publishing-layer concern and is not measured here.

cases.description: Guidance only: there is no evidence to write from.

candidates.content: I built a distributed system that handles millions of requests.
candidates.rationale: Asserts an achievement with no evidence supplied.

expected.explanation: Guidance is not evidence; the context is insufficient and nothing may publish.

cases.description: The reasoner cited evidence the context does not hold.

candidates.content: I containerized the build with Docker so the same image ran locally and in CI.
candidates.rationale: Cites a source the supplied context does not contain.

expected.explanation: A citation the context does not hold is a rejection, not a revision.

cases.description: The reasoner returned an empty draft.

provenance.notes: Evidence chunk paraphrases a containerized CI lesson; the candidate is empty.

documents.content: Containerizing the CI build with Docker removed the drift between my machine and the pipeline.

candidates.rationale: Nothing was generated.

cases.description: A strong-sounding claim resting on UNVERIFIED evidence.

provenance.notes: Evidence carries the corpus's UNVERIFIED state.

documents.content: I deployed the API to production last month and it served live traffic.

candidates.content: I deployed the API to production last month and it served live traffic.
candidates.rationale: Rests entirely on UNVERIFIED evidence.

expected.explanation: UNVERIFIED evidence supports nothing, whatever the claim says.

cases.description: A claim resting on STALE evidence.

provenance.notes: Evidence carries the corpus's STALE state.

documents.content: My backend service uses Flask with a MySQL database and Redis cache.

candidates.content: My backend service uses Flask with a MySQL database and a Redis cache.
candidates.rationale: Rests entirely on STALE evidence.

expected.explanation: STALE evidence was superseded and cannot ground a claim.

cases.description: A specific metric absent from the cited evidence.

provenance.notes: Evidence chunk describes an optimization without a number.

documents.content: I optimized the quizey database queries by adding indexes on the columns used most often.

candidates.content: I optimized the quizey database queries and cut response time by 40%.
candidates.rationale: States 40%, which is in none of the cited evidence.

expected.explanation: Exact references are string-matched against cited evidence; 40% is fabricated.

cases.description: A figure present only in evidence the draft did not cite — a revision, not a rejection.

provenance.notes: One cited and one uncited evidence chunk; the figure lives only in the uncited one.

documents.content: I optimized the quizey database queries by adding indexes on the columns used most often.
The quizey page load dropped after I reduced round trips, a 40% improvement in response time.

candidates.content: I optimized the quizey database queries and cut response time by 40%.
candidates.rationale: The 40% is real but lives in evidence the draft did not cite; citing E2 would fix it.

expected.explanation: Under-attribution is revisable: the fix is to cite the evidence that carries the figure.

cases.description: Held-out in-progress lab that mentions deploying; the evidence carries the deployment word so it is not a forbidden inference.

cases.description: Held-out catalog/index chunk cannot support a dated claim.

provenance.notes: Index-card shape like a data/*/README.md catalog entry. Tests the deterministic reference check on a year; a bare count is not an extracted reference and this gate does not claim to catch one.

documents.content:
## Certificates
- IBM RAG
- IBM Agentic AI

candidates.content: I earned 5 IBM certificates in 2023.
candidates.rationale: Asserts a specific date the catalog index does not carry.

expected.explanation: A catalog index states no dates; the year 2023 is an exact reference the cited evidence does not carry, so the claim is rejected.

cases.description: KNOWN LIMITATION: a fabricated bare count with no unit is not detected.

known_limitation.expectation: A correct gate would reject a fabricated count, because a catalog index does not state one.
known_limitation.why: extract_references matches percentages, versions, years and unit-bearing quantities; a bare integer ('5') produces no reference, so the exact-string reference check has nothing to fail on.

provenance.notes: Index-card shape like a data/*/README.md catalog entry. This case is a probe, not a scored fixture: it measures a documented gate weakness and is excluded from all scored metrics and from the quality gate.

documents.content:
## Certificates
- IBM RAG
- IBM Agentic AI

candidates.content: I hold 5 IBM certificates.
candidates.rationale: Asserts a bare count that nothing in the evidence states.

expected.explanation: Probe only. The reviewed expectation is REJECTED, but the current deterministic gate is known not to detect a bare count; the evaluator records the escape rather than scoring it.

cases.description: Held-out: no documents at all.

provenance.notes: No evidence documents; an empty context is still a valid, explicitly-insufficient context.

candidates.content: I built a scalable system that serves many users.
candidates.rationale: Nothing to ground it.

expected.explanation: An empty context is insufficient, not a prompt to invent.
